sourcePin.title: Capability-based security
sourcePin.license: CC BY-SA; original synthesis with attribution; no source text republished
sourcePin.limitation: Documented architecture and explanations, not proprietary implementation access or a physical teardown

reasons: Summary accurately reflects source definitions of capabilities as unforgeable tokens binding object references to access rights
Mechanisms correctly describe OS-enforced storage in protected kernel memory and controlled operations on capabilities
Unknowns properly identify gaps about partial OS support, hardware requirements, orthogonal persistence necessity, and POSIX limitations
No unsupported mechanisms or invented execution details present
Qualifiers like 'typically' and 'in theory' preserved from source text
